title: Las Vegas Mexican Salsa Cooking Experience with Celebrity Chef
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience an unforgettable cooking class led by a renowned Mexico City chef, featured on Top Chef VIP Telemundo and trusted by Disney, HBO, Coca-Cola, and Meta. Master four classic Mexican salsas with raw, roasted, boiled, and fried methods, indulge in unlimited chips, cheesy handmade quesadillas, authentic Mexican flan, and refreshing agua fresca. Perfect for travelers, foodies, and groups, this hands-on culinary celebration blends delicious recipes, vibrant culture, and the expertise of one of Mexico’s most acclaimed chefs.
